notes.title: Update and Maintaining Notice
notes.notes: Dear Captains in Voyage Senki VR, here we inform you that our game will have a update and maintaining today, from 17:00--23:00 30th July (Beijing Time). It will fix some bugs in game after the maintaining, and we will close the rank list system temporarily. Thanks for your attention.

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.notes:
Dear users of Voyage Senki VR, thanks for all of your patience. After several weeks hard working, the new client of our game is ready! We will update it to Steam on July 13, from 14:00-16:00(Beijing time). The game server will be closed and maintained during the time.
The new client update need to clear all old data of our game as it has many new systems added in the client. The new client will be updated automatically after the maintaining when users start the former client.

Update Contents
1、Cross-platform in VR, PC and mobile. The Voyage Senki VR users on the Steam will be able to connect to users of PC and mobile clients in China. The users from different devices will be able to play together in a server.
2、Add Ranking system in game. Player can check the rank of yourself and other players.
3、Add ship building and upgrading system. Player can select and upgrade the selected ship in game.
4、Add Chatting system in VR(testing model). VR users can see the online users and the message in the world channel in game. But VR users still can’t to chat with other users now.
5、Add self-aiming function in battle. The attack will be lock to the nearest enemy ship or construction.
6、Optimized ship skill CD display. Move into the headset and can draw with the right controller.
7、Optimized MOBA view setting. Ships will not show if it is out of the view.
8、Gold self collecting function. The dropped gold will be collected into your ship automatically, if it is in range 400.
9、Optimized the tutorial system and add loading picture in game starting.
10、Self-checking for the server connecting. System will connect to the server with better condition for users.
11、Add magic book video and two new icon in game.
12、Fix bugs.

notes.title: The Alpha test of Cross-platform version on Voyage Senki VR
notes.notes:
Dear Captains, Voyage Senki VR has been on the Steam for around two months. We have learned a lot of things about improving our game quality, operation, and content from our users. We thanks all our users for your trying and concerning. 

We are planning to go next step of our game developing now. At the beginning of Voyage Senki development, we have planed to make a sea battle game crossing PC and Mobile, then we decided to add VR in at Oct, 2016. After almost 18 months working, here comes the Voyage Senki VR on the Steam. But we still hold our dream that we can make a game playing on PC, mobile, VR together. In the last month, we are working for it hardly, and we are preparing to Alpha test soon. 

For the Steam users, here we have to say sorry firstly, because we plan to do Alpha test of cross-platform version of game in China. There are two reasons make us have this decision. First, this test need to rearrange game server design and set up new server on different countries, which means we have to clear up all the data of game. Also, the PC and mobile clients are requested which we haven’t to put it on IOS and Google App store. Second, this is the first game crossing-platform in the world as we know, we even don’t know how many and what kind of problem may happens. If we put the test on the Steam, we are afraid to lose control of test by communication, translation or others unexpected problem. That is why we choose a small group users in China to do our Alpha test. We hope our users on Steam can understand it. 

In this test we will check some aspects of Voyage Senki including:
The stability of each client including new VR version, PC, and mobile.
Data intercommunication of each client including ID logging, data reading and display on different platform.
Crossing-clients game playing. Users from PC, VR, and mobile can be matched and play together in Island raid and MOBA sea battle.
New game system as Ship building and upgrading, RPG system in PC and mobile version, Matching system, etc.
For VR, it will has Ship building and upgrading system, Matching system. More systems will be added in the future.

This test is planing to take one month. After that we will update the new VR version on the Steam. We will offer a gift package for our Steam users when the update is ready. Also, if you know Chinese and want to know progress, or join the Alpha test in China, welcome to visit our official website in Chinese http://sea.gamewan.com/ to see more details.

notes.title: Game Update 更新公告
notes.notes:
Our third update is from 10:30--12:00 8th May(Beijing Time)
Version 1.0.3 Update 
1, UI display and game graphics improvement
2, Tutorial adjustment: move tutorial to the captain cabin, add Skip button, change steps of tutorial, add lots of animals in island for hunting.
3, UI adjustment
4, Open ship building system
5, improve special effect and transfer light marks
6, improve function choice setting, add light marks to help users choose function
7, Fix bugs on magic books 

本次更新时间定于北京时间5月8日10:30-12:00
1. 修改了显示效果，画面与UI更清晰。
2. 新手岛屿加了大量的动物，可以被炮弹击中。
3. 将新手入场的地图改为了船长室，船长室就像个主界面，链接各个地图与功能。
4. 新手帮助顺序进行了调整。
5. 制作了教学关卡可以跳过的功能。
6. 将对战按钮改为网络对战。
7. 添加建造船只的功能。
8. 添加数据埋点。
9. 修改了错别字与翻译不当的词语。
10. 引导特效的效果有点太急促了，调整的缓慢一些，让人更加的舒缓。
11. 更传送门、开箱子，对战等功能，全部添加射线，可以原地不动选到各种功能。
12. 魔法书标签页添加说明，手柄划过时会有显示。
13. 修改标签页有时候失灵的情况。
14. 传送光标靠近玩家时缩小。

Update contents

1, add two new monsters in tutorial
2, arrow speed adjustment of archers’ in island attack and defence
3, fix bugs in tutorial map
4, improve UI of ship steering
5, add HP and crystal energy display on right controller
6, add enemy ship sign in MOBA
7, optimize details in tutorial map
8, optimize display in sea battle
9, optimize starting setting, decrease starting time
10, optimize notice setting in MOBA.

内容包括：

1.新手地图添加两个海怪和一个九头蛇怪物。
2.岛屿站弓箭手的弓箭速度调整。
